You are auditing part of an "Agentic Design Workflow" repo at /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/Zimmermann-Handover — a client design/handover project for "Zimmermann" (fashion retail website redesign). The repo has a component-library extraction pipeline: an `/extract` skill pulls components from Figma into `02-design/library/elements/[name]/`, each folder holding a custom element JS file named `zimm-[name].js` (the component prefix is "zimm"), a `demo.html`, and sometimes an `assets/` subfolder. A generated contract file at `02-design/library/contract/zimm-contract.js` is supposed to document every component's tier, attributes, slots, and accessibility notes (per a 5-tier atomic design model), validated by `02-design/library/contract/validate.mjs`. Shared design tokens live as CSS custom properties in `02-design/library/common.css`, documented in `02-design/library/tokens.md`.

This is a READ-ONLY audit — do not modify any files. Your job:

1. List every folder under `02-design/library/elements/` (expected: add-to-wishlist, button, footer, icon, logo, nav-item, navigation, product-card) and check each has a `zimm-*.js` file and a `demo.html`. Flag any folder missing either.
2. Read `02-design/library/contract/zimm-contract.js` and cross-check it against the actual element folders: does every element folder have a matching contract entry, and does every contract entry point to a real element folder? List any mismatches by name.
3. Read `02-design/library/contract/README.md` for how to invoke the validator, then actually run it (likely `node validate.mjs` or similar from the `contract/` folder — check for a Node.js runtime and any needed deps first). Report the exact output (pass/fail, and any error/warning lines verbatim).
4. Skim (don't deep-review) each component's `zimm-*.js` file for concrete, obvious issues: broken/missing imports, hardcoded colors or spacing that should reference `common.css` tokens instead, missing accessibility attributes (aria-*, roles, keyboard handling) on interactive elements, or dead/unreachable code. Only report clear, specific findings with file:line — skip stylistic nitpicks.
5. Open `common.css` and `tokens.md` side by side: do the custom properties actually defined in `common.css` match what `tokens.md` documents? Flag any token documented but not defined, or defined but undocumented. Also flag any obviously duplicate or unused custom properties if easy to spot.

Report back in under 500 words: a findings list grouped as "Blocking / structural gaps" vs "Code quality notes" vs "Documentation drift", each item as `path — one-sentence description`. State plainly if a section had no issues. Do not propose or apply fixes, this is audit only.

1	# Component contract
2	
3	The contract is the single source of truth for the component API. Every component
4	that exists (its name, tier, attributes, slots, composition, and accessibility
5	requirements) is recorded here. If it is not in the contract, it does not exist.
6	
7	---
8	
9	## What is in this folder
10	
11	| File | What it is |
12	|---|---|
13	| `[prefix]-contract.js` | The contract: an array of component definitions. Generated and maintained by `/extract`. |
14	| `validate.mjs` | Checks the atomic model rules against the contract. Run before any handover. |
15	
16	---
17	
18	## How to read a contract entry
19	
20	```js
21	{
22	  name:      "Button",          // PascalCase component name
23	  prefix:    "ds",              // tag namespace (from project.config.js)
24	  element:   "ds-button",       // the custom element tag
25	  atomic:    "atom",            // atom | molecule | organism
26	  composes:  [],                // elements this component renders in its own template
27	  attributes: [
28	    { name: "variant", type: "enum",    values: ["primary","secondary","ghost"], default: "primary" },
29	    { name: "size",    type: "enum",    values: ["sm","md","lg"],                default: "md" },
30	    { name: "disabled",type: "boolean",                                          default: false },
31	  ],
32	  slots: [
33	    { name: "default", description: "Button label text" },
34	  ],
35	  a11y:      "role=button, aria-disabled when disabled, keyboard: Enter and Space activate",
36	  status:    "final",           // draft | in-review | final
37	  extracted: "2026-07-07",
38	}
39	```
40	
41	**`atomic`**: the component's tier, determined by what it renders in its own template:
42	- `atom`: renders no other component. `composes: []`.
43	- `molecule`: renders only atoms.
44	- `organism`: renders at least one molecule.
45	
46	`template` and `page` are not valid contract tiers. They are layout-layer deliverables, not Custom Elements. See atomic model Rule F in `.claude/skills/_shared/atomic-model.md`.
47	
48	**`composes`**: what the component's own template renders. Slotted children are not listed here (see atomic model Rule B). This determines the tier and build order: build atoms first, then molecules, then organisms.
49	
50	**`attributes`**: the component's public API. These map directly to `observedAttributes` in the Custom Element. Types:
51	- `enum`: a fixed set of values. Use the `default` if none is passed or the value is unrecognised.
52	- `boolean`: present = true, absent = false.
53	- `string`: freeform content.
54	
55	**`slots`**: named `"default"` is the element's child content. Named slots use `slot="[name]"` on a child element.
56	
57	---
58	
59	## How to implement a component
60	
61	1. Read the contract entry for your component.
62	2. Build one Custom Element per entry. The `element` value is the tag to register.
63	3. `composes` → your imports. Build those components first.
64	4. `attributes` → your `observedAttributes` array and prop defaults.
65	5. `slots` → your shadow DOM slot elements.
66	6. `a11y` → bake in. Assert in tests.
67	7. All styles reference CSS custom properties from `02-design/library/common.css`.
68	   No hardcoded values.
69	
70	## Definition of done (per component)
71	
72	- One Custom Element matching the contract API
73	- All `observedAttributes` match the contract `attributes` list
74	- All slots match the contract `slots` list
75	- `composes` matches what the template actually renders
76	- No props or imports beyond the contract entry
77	- Light and dark themes verified
78	- `node 02-design/library/contract/validate.mjs` passes with no violations
79	
80	---
81	
82	## Adding a new component
83	
84	If a design needs a component not in the contract, **stop and flag it** as a proposed
85	addition. Do not invent a component, attribute, or token outside the contract. Raising
86	it means agreeing on the API, classifying the tier, extracting it via `/extract`, and
87	adding the entry here.
88	
89	---
90	
91	## Running the validator
92	
93	```sh
94	node 02-design/library/contract/validate.mjs
95	```
96	
97	Checks contract integrity and scans all `demo.html` files for unknown element tags.
98	Exit 0 = clean. Exit 1 = violations listed.

```js
}
```

**`atomic`**: the component's tier, determined by what it renders in its own template:
- `atom`: renders no other component. `composes: []`.
- `molecule`: renders only atoms.
- `organism`: renders at least one molecule.

`template` and `page` are not valid contract tiers. They are layout-layer deliverables, not Custom Elements. See atomic model Rule F in `.claude/skills/_shared/atomic-model.md`.

**`composes`**: what the component's own template renders. Slotted children are not listed here (see atomic model Rule B). This determines the tier and build order: build atoms first, then molecules, then organisms.

**`attributes`**: the component's public API. These map directly to `observedAttributes` in the Custom Element. Types:
- `enum`: a fixed set of values. Use the `default` if none is passed or the value is unrecognised.
- `boolean`: present = true, absent = false.
- `string`: freeform content.

**`slots`**: named `"default"` is the element's child content. Named slots use `slot="[name]"` on a child element.

---

## How to implement a component

1. Read the contract entry for your component.
2. Build one Custom Element per entry. The `element` value is the tag to register.
3. `composes` → your imports. Build those components first.
4. `attributes` → your `observedAttributes` array and prop defaults.
5. `slots` → your shadow DOM slot elements.
6. `a11y` → bake in. Assert in tests.
7. All styles reference CSS custom properties from `02-design/library/common.css`.
   No hardcoded values.

## Definition of done (per component)

- One Custom Element matching the contract API
- All `observedAttributes` match the contract `attributes` list
- All slots match the contract `slots` list
- `composes` matches what the template actually renders
- No props or imports beyond the contract entry
- Light and dark themes verified
- `node 02-design/library/contract/validate.mjs` passes with no violations

---

## Adding a new component

If a design needs a component not in the contract, **stop and flag it** as a proposed
addition. Do not invent a component, attribute, or token outside the contract. Raising
it means agreeing on the API, classifying the tier, extracting it via `/extract`, and
adding the entry here.

---

## Running the validator

```sh
node 02-design/library/contract/validate.mjs
```

Checks contract integrity and scans all `demo.html` files for unknown element tags.
Exit 0 = clean. Exit 1 = violations listed.

## Audit Findings — Zimmermann Component Library (`02-design/library/`)

**Scope note:** Read-only audit, no files modified. Node v24.18.0 was available; validator ran with no extra deps needed.

### Blocking / structural gaps
No issues found in folder completeness or contract mapping.
- All 8 expected folders exist (`add-to-wishlist, button, footer, icon, logo, nav-item, navigation, product-card`), each containing a `zimm-*.js`, `demo.html`, and `assets/`. None missing either required file.
- `02-design/library/contract/zimm-contract.js` — all 8 contract entries map 1:1 to the 8 element folders by name; no orphaned contract entries and no folders missing a contract entry.
- `node validate.mjs` (run from `02-design/library/contract/`) exits **0**, output verbatim: `Contract: 8 components (5 atoms, 3 molecules, 0 organisms).` / `Demo files checked: 8 tag usages.` / `✓ Atomic model valid. All tags in demo files resolve to contract entries.` No warnings/errors printed.
- Tooling gap worth flagging: `validate.mjs` only prints flagged issues via an entry's `gap` field, but every contract entry actually uses a `note` field instead (e.g. Footer's note documents a real token discrepancy and a missing icon type). Since no entry uses `gap`, the validator's notes-reporting path never fires — the clean output above masks known issues already written into the contract prose.

### Code quality notes
- `02-design/library/elements/logo/zimm-logo.js:19` — `--fill-0: var(--zimm-color-text-01);` references a custom property that doesn't exist anywhere in `common.css` (likely meant `--zimm-color-text-default`); default-variant logo fill silently resolves to the CSS-invalid fallback.
- Hardcoded `1px solid` borders duplicate the existing `--zimm-border-width-default` token instead of using it: `zimm-nav-item.js:42`, `zimm-footer.js:59,102-103`, `zimm-navigation.js:144`.
- `zimm-navigation.js:147` — `width: 180px` on `.search-input` is an untokenized magic number, not listed anywhere in `tokens.md`'s candidates table.
